chapter_title: A Multi-Level Analysis of World Scientific Output in Pharmacology
source_pdf: /mnt/project-files/Experimental Provenance for QSAR Dataset/Pharmacology (Luca Gallelli) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf
chapter_notes: Chapter names no mechanisms of action. It is a bibliometric (scientometric) study of pharmacology publications in Scopus, 1996-2009: output and citations by region, country, journal and pharmaceutical company, plus R&D spending figures. No compound, drug class or molecular target is named anywhere in the body text, tables (1-5), figure captions (1-7) or footnotes; company and journal names are the only proper nouns. The reference list starts part-way down PDF page 365 (printed 353), after the Conclusions and Acknowledgement; page 366 is reference list only.
